title: Indian-origin man rejected for H-1B three times, spent $13,000 and formed 700 pages of evidence to stay in US
summary_full: Sohan Sethi faced multiple H-1B visa rejections after arriving in the United States. He then pursued an O-1 visa, requiring extensive documentation and lawyer fees. Sethi demonstrated extraordinary ability through achievements and industry recognition to secure his stay. This path highlights the challenges faced by skilled professionals seeking to remain in America. He now manages a team, sharing his experience to guide others through the process.
